_why: The audit's answer key. drills/audit.py discovers external dependencies from the tree and refuses anything that is not in here. Every entry is either covered_by a drill id or dismissed with a reason, and there is no third state, because an unclassified dependency is one nobody has decided about.

api.anthropic.com.is: the vendor every agent thinks with

api.cerebras.ai.is: substrate rail, has a key and is not in the drill's rail list

api.fly.io.is: the Fly control plane every deploy and secret goes through
api.fly.io.dismissed: the estate is moving off Fly, founder 2026-08-23. It returns to this file named for the platform that replaces it

api.mistral.ai.is: substrate rail and the only working agent rail

api.telegram.org.is: the only channel that reaches the founder

auth.kimi.com.dismissed: the same vendor as api.kimi.com; drilling a vendor twice does not drill it harder

claude.ai.is: the vendor surface policy/hooks.rego refuses to publish founder-facing pages to
claude.ai.dismissed: losing it costs nothing by construction. The only reference in this tree is the refusal text naming it, and the rule's whole point is that the founder's board is http://127.0.0.1:8787/, served by board_serve.py from a file on this machine. The one time a session did publish there he opened the link and got a 404, which is the incident the rule exists for.

console.anthropic.com.dismissed: a browser page for a human, not a call any code makes

fly.io.is: Fly's own site and API surface
fly.io.dismissed: the estate is moving off Fly, founder 2026-08-23. It returns to this file named for the platform that replaces it

generativelanguage.googleapis.com.is: substrate rail, prepaid credits empty since 2026-08-23

hc-ping.com.dismissed: Not a dependency. The estate standard is Healthchecks self-hosted (BSD-3, docs/STANDARDS.md), and hc-wrap.sh names this host only in a comment recording that the hosted URL shape omits the /ping/ segment. If the hosted service vanished the estate would not notice. Losing our OWN receiver is the real risk, and that is what MON-1 and MON-4 in ~/.estate/REQUIREMENTS.jsonl grade hourly.

healthchecks.io.is: the project's documentation and hosted service
healthchecks.io.dismissed: Not a dependency. Read once on 2026-08-24 to get the ping protocol right; the URL survives in a comment as a citation. The software is BSD-3 and vendored by us, so the exit from the hosted service is the deployment we already run.

hermes-agent.nousresearch.com.is: named in an archived hermes config

huggingface.co.dismissed: nothing scheduled reads it; a local model already downloaded survives the host going away

mumchimp.com.dismissed: no scheduled job calls it. It belongs on the register the day something does

opencode.ai.is: the $schema URL in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json and its .jsonc twin
opencode.ai.dismissed: a JSON Schema identifier, fetched by an editor for completion and by nothing this estate runs. opencode parses the file whether or not the host answers. Same class as the plist DTD host above.

openrouter.ai.is: substrate rail, proves Anthropic is replaceable

prospector-store-api.fly.dev.dismissed: the estate is moving off Fly, founder 2026-08-23. It returns to this file named for the platform that replaces it

registry.npmjs.org.dismissed: build-time only; no scheduled job installs from it

www.apple.com.dismissed: a schema identifier in every plist header. It is not fetched

www.cloudflare.com.dismissed: same. The R2 bucket that matters is reached through an account-specific endpoint, not this host

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.is: the vendor every agent thinks with

CLAUDE_API_KEY.is: the same vendor under a second name

MISTRAL_API_KEY.is: substrate rail and the agent rail

TELEGRAM_TOKEN.is: the only channel that reaches the founder

CEREBRAS_API_KEY.is: substrate rail with a key and no rail in the drill
CEREBRAS_API_KEY.dismissed: no scheduled job uses it. It is a spare, and a spare nobody calls is not a dependency

LANGCHAIN_API_KEY.dismissed: observability for a thing that is not running

CONSULT_TOKEN.is: auth between two local processes on this Mac
CONSULT_TOKEN.dismissed: local, and it dies with the machine the rebuild drill already covers

BLOB_KEY.is: the path of the escrow object inside the R2 bucket, not a credential

ICLOUD_KEY.is: the path of the recovery private key in iCloud Drive; the key it names is what opens the escrow

LOCAL_KEY.is: the path of the same recovery key at ~/.config/estate, the copy a scheduled job can read
